name: Yellowhead / 82 Street
centre_note: Alberta Structure-Export.csv record 41170 (82 STREET - YELLOWHEAD TRAIL (B224)), LATITUDE 53.5821522814449, LONGITUDE -113.467305324759. Used because the record is found and the point sits on the crossing (about 2 m from an OSM node where three ramp ways meet at the 82 Street and Yellowhead ramp junction). The PRIORITY.md and bridge-geometry.json estimate, 53.578, -113.462, is about 579 m south-east of this point and was not used. The cached Y71 object (retrieved 2026-10-14) was centred on that estimate; its bridge ways are Capital Line light rail and a disused rail yard about 1.3 km south-south-east, so it does not describe this crossing.
geometry_source: Live OpenStreetMap API 0.6 map call, bbox -113.4823,53.5722,-113.4523,53.5922 (centred on the record point, not clipped), retrieved 2026-11-23. The cached Y71 object in docs/edmonton-bridges/bridge-geometry.json was not edited and was not used for geometry.
plan_length_note: plan_length_m is the horizontal WGS84 length of each OSM way, computed along its nodes with a spherical (haversine) formula. Approach, ramp and road-beneath lengths are plan lengths of whole ways. They are not the climb to grade and not a structural length. The published nominal span is 34.2 m (Alberta record 41170).
dropped_note: Dropped: CN rail bridge ways 23427569, 37831895, 37831899, 37831900, 37831901 (CNR over 82 Street, record 41690, a different structure about 165 m north). Yellowhead frontage roads (unclassified, named Yellowhead Trail NW) 256516545 and 46894694. Service roads, alleys and a long cycleway beyond the footprint. No way was dropped for carrying a different Y-code; the extract has none.

road_beneath.which: Yellowhead Trail NW (Highway 16) eastbound carriageway beneath the 82 Street deck. Tagged layer -1 and tunnel=yes; in OSM those tags mark an underpass, not a tunnel. maxheight=5.2 on this way matches the Alberta theoretical vertical clearance under the structure (5.2 m, record 41170). That is a theoretical figure, not a measured one. Node order west to east.
Yellowhead Trail NW (Highway 16) westbound carriageway beneath the 82 Street deck. Tagged layer -1 and tunnel=yes; underpass in OSM terms. No maxheight tag. Node order east to west.
